document_title: TTS Voice Engine Options - What Each One Does
description: A complete guide to what you experience with each voice engine option

choosing_a_voice_engine.when_this_happens: During configuration, after selecting your EPUB file
choosing_a_voice_engine.what_you_see: A numbered list of available voice engines

edge_tts_online_voices.when_available: Always shown if your computer has internet access

selecting_edge_tts.next_prompt: 'Enter Edge-TTS voice name (press Enter for default: en-US-GuyNeural):'
selecting_edge_tts.if_you_press_enter: The default male American voice is used
selecting_edge_tts.if_you_type_a_voice: That specific voice is used (e.g., 'en-US-JennyNeural' for female)

during_processing.what_you_see: Progress updates as each chapter is sent to Microsoft's servers
during_processing.speed: Usually takes 1-2 minutes per chapter depending on internet speed

what_happens_next: After 3 retries: '❌ Edge-TTS failed. Switch to Piper offline voice? (y/n)'
if_internet_drops.if_you_say_yes: The program switches to Piper and continues

if_rate_limited.what_this_means: You made too many requests too fast, Microsoft temporarily blocked you
if_rate_limited.what_you_see: '⚠️ Rate limited by Edge-TTS. Waiting 30 seconds...'
if_rate_limited.what_happens: The program automatically waits and retries

voice_quality.pros: Most natural sounding, wide variety of voices and accents
voice_quality.cons: Requires internet, can fail or be slow, limited by Microsoft's policies

piper_offline_voices.when_available: Shown if Piper is installed and voice models are found in piper_models folder

selecting_piper.what_you_do: Type the number for Piper and press Enter
selecting_piper.next_prompt: A list of available voice models
selecting_piper.what_you_do_next: Type the number of the voice you want

if_no_models_found.what_you_see: '⚠️ No Piper models found. Please add .onnx files to piper_models folder.'
if_no_models_found.what_to_do: Download voice models from the Piper website and place them in the piper_models folder

during_processing.what_you_see: Progress as audio is generated locally on your computer
during_processing.speed: Usually faster than Edge-TTS because no internet needed
during_processing.no_failures_from: Internet issues, rate limiting, or server problems

voice_quality.pros: Works offline, very reliable, high quality neural voices, no usage limits
voice_quality.cons: Need to download model files first, fewer voice options than Edge-TTS

piper_offline_voices.why_this_is_recommended: The project focuses on Piper because it's the most reliable and produces professional results without internet dependency

pyttsx3_system_voices.when_available: Always available on Windows and usually on Linux

selecting_pyttsx3.next_prompt: A list of voices installed on your computer

during_processing.what_you_see: Progress as your computer's built-in speech synthesizer generates audio
during_processing.speed: Very fast because it uses basic speech synthesis

voice_quality.pros: Works offline, no setup needed, very fast
voice_quality.cons: Sounds robotic and unnatural, not recommended for YouTube content

pyttsx3_system_voices.when_to_use: Only as a last resort if other options don't work

chatterbox_premium_voices.when_available: Only shown if Chatterbox is installed and GPU is detected

selecting_chatterbox.what_happens: The system checks if your GPU has enough memory

gpu_requirements.what_you_need: A GPU with at least 4GB VRAM (NVIDIA recommended)
gpu_requirements.if_no_gpu: '⚠️ Chatterbox requires a GPU. Falling back to Piper.'

during_processing.what_you_see: Progress as your GPU generates audio
during_processing.speed: Slower than other options because it's doing more complex AI processing
during_processing.warning_shown: 'Note: Chatterbox uses more resources. Processing may take longer.'

voice_quality.pros: Highest quality, emotional expression, sounds most human
voice_quality.cons: Requires GPU, slowest option, uses more power

chatterbox_premium_voices.special_use_case: Used in AI multi-speaker mode for character dialogue to make characters sound distinct

speed_adjustment.when_asked: After selecting voice engine and voice

what_the_values_mean.+10%: 10% faster than normal (good for action scenes)

voice_testing.when_this_happens: Before processing begins, if you're using Edge-TTS
voice_testing.what_is_generated: A short test phrase is spoken
voice_testing.if_test_fails: '❌ Voice test failed' with options to switch engines
